svg.title: A handler must distinguish a valid request from malformed input
svg.desc: A launch failure produces no handler decision. Once started, malformed input is handled as a denial at exit zero. A valid but out-of-scope event or tool produces an empty response with no policy decision. A matched valid patch is denied when a protected target matches, or produces no objection otherwise. Exit zero means the handler produced its response; the JSON and client policy determine the effect.
